dict.string: MacCleaner looks for visually similar photos in your Photos library so you can remove duplicates. Photos are analyzed on this Mac only.
MacCleaner uses Apple Events to manage login items (System Events), empty Mail's trash, and run administrator commands you approve.
MacCleaner scans your Desktop for large, old and duplicate files.
MacCleaner scans your Documents for large, old and duplicate files.
MacCleaner scans your Downloads for large, old and duplicate files, and saves app updates there.
MacCleaner can scan and empty the Trash on external drives.
MacCleaner can scan folders on network drives you choose.
